```

open CategoryTheory
open LeanFormal.IUT
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1896BoundaryCuspActual

#check @S1896WhiskerLeftIso
#check @S1896WhiskerRightIso
#check @S1896LeftUnitorIso
#check @S1896RightUnitorIso
#check @S1896WhiskerRightId
#check @S1896WhiskerExchange
#check @S1896WhiskerRightIff
#check @S1896Modification_subsingleton
#check @S1896App_one_eq_id
#check @S1896YonedaOneIso
#check @S1896YonedaOneIso_app_one
#check @S1896IdentityProjectionMap
#check @S1896IdentityCommutes
#check @S1896IdentitySquare
#check @S1896IdentityPullback
#check @S1896IdentityBaseChange
#check @S1896IdentityOpenImmersion
#check @S1896Id_app_essSurj
#check @S1896Id_not_boundary
#check @S1896Cusp_openMap_app_not_essSurj
#check @S1896CuspOpenData
#check @S1896CuspPointData
#check @S1896CuspOpenDataOfCusp
#check @S1896CuspEquivOpenData
#check @S1896Cusp_nonempty_iff_openData
#check @S1896FirstMissing_structure
#check @S1896D9Cusp_identity_not_openImmersion

-- the constructed open immersion really has the required type, at the D9 field
example (F : Type) [Field F] (Y : EtaleStackOverField F) :
    @EtaleStackOpenImmersion F _ Y Y (Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.id Y.fiber) :=
  S1896IdentityOpenImmersion Y
`;
await tools.write({ file_path: "D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\_S1896ImportProbe.lean", content: probe });
const r = await tools.pwsh({ description: "Recompile import probe", command: "lake env lean tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1896ImportProbe.lean 2>&1 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1896ImportProbe.log; Write-Output ('PROBE_EXIT=' + $LASTEXITCODE); Write-Output ('ERRORS=' + ((Get-Content tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1896ImportProbe.log | Select-String -Pattern 'error').Count)); Write-Output ('CHECKS=' + ((Get-Content tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1896ImportProbe.log | Select-String -Pattern '^@S1896|^S1896').Count)); Write-Output ('LINES=' + (Get-Content tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1896BoundaryCuspActual.lean).Count); Write-Output ('PROBE_SHA=' + (Get-FileHash tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1896ImportProbe.lean -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)", timeoutMs: 900000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? r.stdout.text : JSON.stringify(r));
", "description": "Validate olean import and declaration checks"}
